description: Normative core diagnostics vocabulary for the private-asset profile. The gateway publishes it (GET /contracts/diagnostics-vocabulary.json) and the vendor-adapter imports it to route mapped fields. A mapped field named as a core key is published at the top of the diagnostics, every other mapped name under the vendorSpecific bag, carried as authored. The vendor schema's mapping (format, transform) brings a value to the core unit. A core time is published in RFC 3339 UTC.
